coordination.body: Receiving coordination for #17 / PR #19: the first actual candidate ran 68 tests, with all 19 new actual-WASM/browser cases and original offline package parity passing. Its eight failures are the existing save-browser cases waiting for startup: their private files Map in tests/watch-save.browser.test.mjs does not serve the new watch-choice.js import or its model/CSS dependencies. I propose only three exact allow-list entries for /watch-choice.js, /watch-choice-model.js (text/javascript) and /watch-choice.css (text/css). All save assertions, storage fixtures, server behavior, production SavedWatch and owner #12 file lifecycle remain unchanged. Failed head 6adc15d3 and raw CI job113344216892 are retained. Parent is independently receiving this narrow dependency closure before publication; the original frozen nine-case browser fixture remains exact.
